4. ESTABLISH – NO STOPPING, EXCEPT BICYCLES
 ESTABLISH – BIKE SHARE STATION
3rd Street, east side, from 42 feet to 116 feet south of the crosswalk at King Street
(74-foot bike share station) (Supervisor District 6) (Approvable by the City Traffic Engineer) Laura
Stonehill, [staff email removed — see the order]



Proposal to move the existing Bay Wheels bike share station on 3rd Street at Townsend Street to the
floating buffer on the east side of 3rd Street, south of King Street, to be adjacent to the new two-way
bikeway next to the Giants stadium.

Public Comments: Comment regarding CEQA approval for relocation or removal of bikeshare
stations. Comment in opposition.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
